title: Barebones Anti Block Rotations
description: This resource pack will change the texture of bedrock to Barebones deepslate fore people using barebones
body:
(out dated)
This resource pack transforms the look of Bedrock blocks into a clean, simplified style inspired by Bare Bones Deepslate. Designed for players who prefer a more minimal and visually consistent Minecraft experience, this pack replaces the default Bedrock texture with a smoother, darker, and more refined appearance that blends seamlessly with deepslate-themed builds.

The new texture keeps the iconic feel of Minecraft while reducing visual noise, making it easier on the eyes during long play sessions. Whether you're building underground bases, mining deep caves, or creating modern or industrial-style structures, the Barebones Deepslate Bedrock texture provides a cohesive aesthetic that enhances immersion without straying too far from the vanilla style.

This pack is perfect for players who enjoy the Bare Bones art direction but want more consistency across all underground blocks. The updated Bedrock texture fits naturally alongside deepslate, blackstone, and other darker materials, helping your builds look more polished and intentional.

Installation is simple, and the pack is lightweight, ensuring it won’t impact performance. It works great in both survival and creative modes, giving you a subtle but noticeable upgrade to one of Minecraft’s most iconic blocks.

If you're looking to modernize your world while keeping things simple and stylish, this Barebones Deepslate Bedrock texture pack is a perfect addition to your Minecraft experience.
